summary: This experimental RFC describes a home agent-assisted route optimization for IPv4 Network Mobility. It is meant for cases where all nodes use a single home agent, such as within one organization. It enables discovery of eligible peer nodes and lets traffic take a more direct path.

eli5.summary: When a moving network sends a message to a friend in the same group, it does not have to go the long way round. This helps them find each other and take a shortcut.
